Callout.Name: Livestock Attacked
Callout.Message: Sheep attacked overnight, predator believed still nearby.
Callout.Advisory: Several dead, owner asking for someone to attend.

Script.Line: Nine sheep down and not one of them will stand up.
It was not a dog on its own. Not with that much damage.
Whatever it was is still out there. The dogs are going mad.

Lines.Approach: Something has been through the flock and the owner thinks it is still about.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
